sourceQuote: Undergraduate applicants who provide TOEFL scores of at least 79 Internet-based (IBT) or an IELTS overall band score of at least 6.0 or TOEIC scores of 750 will be considered for regular admission.
targetQuote: 提供TOEFL成绩且基于互联网的测验（IBT）成绩至少为79，或总分至少为6.0的IELTS，或TOEIC成绩为750的本科申请人，将被考虑获得常规录取。
